title: SEN Class Teacher
summary: Teach pupils aged 5 to 18 with complex needs, including SEMH, at a nurturing specialist provision.
body:
## The position

We're recruiting a dedicated, compassionate SEN class teacher to join a specialist provision in Ipswich. The setting supports pupils aged 5 to 18 with a range of complex needs, including social, emotional and mental health (SEMH) needs.

The school provides a safe, structured and nurturing environment where pupils achieve academically and personally. Staff work collaboratively so every child feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed.

## Key responsibilities

- Plan and deliver engaging, high-quality lessons aligned to the national curriculum and adapted to individual SEMH needs.
- Work closely with support staff to facilitate learning and promote positive behaviour.
- Monitor and report on pupil progress, highlighting any concerns and contributing to reviews.
- Supervise pupils during breaks, enrichment activities and educational visits.
- Build strong, positive relationships with pupils to encourage engagement and improve outcomes.

## What you'll need

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS).
- Degree-level education.
- Proven teaching experience.
- Experience working with pupils with SEMH needs in an educational setting.
- Strong behaviour management skills.
- A commitment to ongoing professional development.
- Willingness to undergo an enhanced DBS check.

## What's on offer

- A supportive and inclusive working environment.
- Ongoing professional development.
- The chance to make a genuine difference to the lives of vulnerable young people.
- A collaborative team focused on positive outcomes for pupils.
